title: The Legend of More Bounce
subtitle: One tiny world seen three ways: overworld, side-view action, and first-person interaction.

price.notes: Production-candidate target only. Public retail release remains blocked until a human worthiness playtest and final store-art review are signed off.

mobileProfile.readabilityTarget: Readable and tappable on 6-inch phones without zoom.

storePageSeed.shortDescription: A tiny retro adventure that jumps between three classic ways of seeing a game world.
storePageSeed.longDescription: The Legend of More Bounce is a compact handcrafted PixelForge adventure starring More Bounce and Princess Larrina. Cross a top-down overworld, enter Wobble Woods as a side-scrolling action scene, recover the Bounce Rune, then step through the Echo Gate into a first-person tower encounter. One shared state follows you through all three perspectives. Built for the 369 PocketGames lane: paid once, offline-friendly, no ads, no subscriptions, and no predatory purchases.
featureBullets: Three perspectives inside one tiny shared world
Top-down overworld exploration, side-view action, and first-person interaction
A complete proof-sized adventure with a clear beginning and ending
Local-first play with no account, telemetry, or network requirement
Paid-once 369 PocketGames design with no ads or predatory IAP
storePageSeed.tagline: One world. Three ways of seeing it.

releaseGates.name: Rights + Creator Credits Gate
releaseGates.criteria: Original/properly licensed assets are declared and creator credits are present.

releaseGates.name: Mobile Readability Gate
releaseGates.criteria: The cartridge passes the PixelForge mobile readability receipt with no errors.

releaseGates.name: Automated Browser Playthrough Gate
releaseGates.criteria: A deterministic browser proof reaches the ending with zero page errors.

releaseGates.name: Offline Package Gate
releaseGates.criteria: A standalone local playable exists and requires no account or network service.

releaseGates.name: SNES Asset Contract Gate
releaseGates.criteria: Required 16-bit asset roles are explicitly declared and audited without pretending missing art exists.

releaseGates.name: Final Required Asset Content Gate
releaseGates.criteria: Every required sprite, tileset, interior, UI, portrait, and effects slot points to a reviewed ready asset before retail release.

releaseGates.name: $3.69 Human Worthiness Gate
releaseGates.criteria: At least one named human playtester can explain why the finished build feels worth the paid-once target price.

releaseGates.name: Final Store Art Gate
releaseGates.criteria: Final icon, feature graphic, and screenshots are reviewed for brand quality and store suitability.
